purpose: Blinded source judgment of eleven connected Xianhe-era military/diplomatic sequel claims; no proposed operations or desired verdicts included
question: Read complete supplied Chinese and judge each claim’s owner and chronology. Distinguish broad 咸和初, narrative reset after a retrospective description of buildings, subsequent 及/後 clauses and the 初…至是 flashback. Do not infer exact calendar years, Liu Yao’s external death year, or life/reign intervals. Preserve any real owner, endpoint or competing-witness conflict; absence of exact years alone need not invalidate a supported bound. Actual death and contemporary reference to earlier events require separate ownership checks. Holds are permissible.

value.unresolvedReason: 咸和初 is an era-opening label, not Xianhe 1–2. s0450–s0454 (及曜攻枹罕, 至是擒趙貞, 及石勒殺劉曜, 勒遣使, 後稱臣) have no new year and cannot be closed as AD 326–327.
value.event: During the opening of Xianhe, Zhang Jun fought Liu Yao in Longxi, lost then recovered Henan, and dealt with Zhao Zhen and Shi Le's envoys.
At the beginning of Xianhe Zhang Jun feared pressure from Liu Yao; Yao then attacked Fuhan and defeated Han Pu and Xin Yan at Lintao.
value.unresolvedReason: 咸和初 is an era-opening label, not a closed year, and s0452 及石勒殺劉曜 is a later undated sequel.

value.event: Zhang Jun sent Han Pu with Xin Yan; they fought at Lintao and were badly defeated by Liu Yao’s army.
value.unresolvedReason: The Lintao defeat is narrated with 及 after 咸和初, without a new year number.

value.event: Xin Yan was sent with Han Pu and was defeated with him at Lintao.
value.unresolvedReason: The Lintao defeat is narrated with 及 after 咸和初, without a new year number.

value.event: Protector Xin Yan at Fuhan reported the emergency when Liu Yao attacked the city.
value.unresolvedReason: 辛晏告急 stands in the 及 clause after 咸和初, without a new year number.

value.event: At this point Zhang Jun attacked and captured Zhao Zhen, who had not submitted, and made his land Gaochang commandery.
value.unresolvedReason: s0451 至是 follows the 咸和初 cluster. 初，戊己校尉趙貞 is a flashback of prior non-submission, not Xianhe 2.

value.event: Shi Le killed Liu Yao; Zhang Jun then recovered Henan as far as Didao and divided the frontier with Le.
value.unresolvedReason: 及石勒殺劉曜 follows the 咸和初 cluster without a new era year. It is not Xianhe 4–8 and not an exact Western death year.

value.event: At the beginning of Xianhe, Zhang Jun sent envoys to Li Xiong and repaired neighborly relations.
value.unresolvedReason: 咸和初 names the era opening, not a closed year. Conventional 咸和元年 = AD 326 (Cheng of Jin); 初 is not rewritten as exact Xianhe 1.

value.event: Shi Le sent envoys to invest Zhang Jun with office and rank; Jun refused and detained the envoys.
value.unresolvedReason: s0453 has no era year after the undated 殺劉曜 notice.

value.event: Later, fearing Le’s strength, Zhang Jun sent envoys declaring himself Le’s subject and sent Le’s envoys back.
value.unresolvedReason: 稱臣於勒 is marked 後 after the undated 殺劉曜 notice, with no era year.
s0452 及石勒殺劉曜 is an undated sequel after 咸和初. Do not import an external AD 329 killing year.
value.event: Shi Le killed Liu Yao, after which Zhang Jun recovered Henan amid the Chang'an disorder.

units.zh: 二府官僚莫不稱臣。
units.en: The officials of the two administrations all styled themselves ministers.
units.literal: The officials of the two administrations all styled themselves ministers.

units.zh: 又于姑臧城南築城，起謙光殿，畫以五色，飾以金玉，窮盡珍巧。
units.en: He also built a walled city south of Guzang and raised the Palace of Humble Radiance, painted in the five colors, ornamented with gold and jade, exhausting every rare and cunning art.
units.literal: He also south of Guzang built a wall and raised the Palace of Humble Radiance, painted in the five colors, ornamented with gold and jade, exhausting every rare and cunning art.

units.zh: 殿之四面各起一殿，東曰宜陽青殿，以春三月居之，章服器物皆依方色；
units.en: On each of the four sides of the hall he raised a hall: east was called Yiyang, the Green Hall, where he dwelt in the third month of spring, and robes and utensils all matched the quarter’s color;
units.literal: On each of the four sides of the hall he raised a hall: east was called Xuanyang, the Green Hall, where he dwelt in the third month of spring, and robes and utensils all matched the quarter’s color;

units.zh: 南曰硃陽赤殿，夏三月居之；
units.en: south was called Zhuyang, the Red Hall, where he dwelt the third month of summer;
units.literal: south was called Zhuyang, the Red Hall, where he dwelt the third month of summer;

units.zh: 西曰政刑白殿，秋三月居之；
units.en: west was called Zhengxing, the White Hall, where he dwelt the third month of autumn;
units.literal: west was called Zhengxing, the White Hall, where he dwelt the third month of autumn;

units.zh: 北曰玄武黑殿，冬三月居之。
units.en: north was called Xuanwu, the Black Hall, where he dwelt the third month of winter.
units.literal: north was called Xuanwu, the Black Hall, where he dwelt the third month of winter.

units.zh: 其傍皆有直省內官寺署，一同方色。
units.en: Beside each were attendant offices, inner bureaux, and departmental offices, all matching that quarter’s color.
units.literal: Beside each were straight offices and inner bureaus, all matching the quarter’s color.

units.zh: 及末年，任所遊處，不復依四時而居。
units.en: In his last years, wherever he roamed and stayed, he no longer followed the four seasons in choosing his residence.
units.literal: In his last years, wherever he roamed and dwelt, he no longer followed the four seasons in choosing halls.

units.zh: 咸和初，懼為劉曜所逼，使將軍宋輯、魏纂將徙隴西南安人二千餘家于姑臧，使聘于李雄，修鄰好。
units.en: At the beginning of Xianhe, fearing pressure from Liu Yao, he moved more than two thousand households from Nan'an in Longxi to Guzang and sent envoys to Li Xiong to renew neighborly relations.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianhe, fearing pressure from Liu Yao, he sent generals Song Ji and Wei Zuan to move more than two thousand households of Nan’an in Longxi to Guzang, sent envoys to Li Xiong, and repaired neighborly friendship.

units.zh: 及曜工攻枹罕，護軍辛晏告急，駿使韓璞、辛岩率步騎二萬擊之，戰於臨洮，大為曜軍所敗，璞等退走，追至令居，駿遂失河南之地。
units.en: When Liu Yao attacked Fuhan in force, Protector Xin Yan reported the emergency. Zhang Jun sent Han Pu and Xin Yan with twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to strike him, but at Lintao they were badly defeated by Yao's army, fled back, and were pursued to Lingju. Zhang Jun thereby lost the territory south of the Yellow River.
units.literal: When Yao attacked Fuhan in force, Protector Xin Yan reported urgent distress; Jun sent Han Pu and Xin Yan with twenty thousand foot and horse to strike him; they fought at Lintao and were greatly defeated by Yao’s army; Pu and the others retreated in flight, were pursued to Lingju, and Jun thereupon lost the territory south of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 初，戊己校尉趙貞不附於駿，至是，駿擊擒之，以其地為高昌郡。
units.en: Earlier, Zhao Zhen, Colonel of Wu and Ji, had not submitted to Zhang Jun. At this point Jun attacked and captured him, making his territory Gaochang Commandery.
units.literal: In the beginning Colonel of the Garrison of Wu and Ji Zhao Zhen had not submitted to Jun; at this point Jun attacked, captured him, and made his territory Gaochang commandery.

units.zh: 及石勒殺劉曜，駿因長安亂，復收河南地，至於狄道，置武衛、石門、候和、漒川、甘松五屯護軍，與勒分境。
units.en: After Shi Le killed Liu Yao, Zhang Jun took advantage of the disorder in Chang'an to recover the territory south of the Yellow River as far as Didao. He established the five garrison protectors of Wuwei, Shimen, Houhe, Qiangchuan, and Gansong, and divided the frontier with Le.
units.literal: When Shi Le killed Liu Yao, Jun because Chang’an was in chaos again recovered Henan territory as far as Didao, established the five garrison protectors of Wuwei, Shimen, Houhe, Qiangchuan, and Gansong, and divided the border with Le.

units.zh: 勒遣使拜駿官爵，駿不受，留其使。
units.en: Le sent envoys to invest Zhang Jun with office and rank, but Jun refused and detained the envoys.
units.literal: Le sent envoys to invest Jun with office and rank; Jun did not accept and detained his envoys.

units.zh: 後懼勒強，遣使稱臣於勒，兼貢方物，遣其使歸。
units.en: Later, fearing Le's strength, Jun sent envoys declaring himself Le's subject, presented local products, and sent Le's envoys back.
units.literal: Later fearing Le’s strength, he sent envoys declaring himself Le’s subject while also presenting local products, and sent Le’s envoys back.

units.zh: 駿境內嘗大饑，穀價踴貴，市長譚詳請出倉谷與百姓，秋收三倍征之。
units.en: A great famine once struck Jun's territory and grain prices soared. Market director Tan Xiang requested that grain from the granaries be issued to the people, then collected back at threefold after the autumn harvest.
units.literal: Within Jun’s borders there was once a great famine; grain prices leaped; market director Tan Xiang asked to release granary grain to the common people and after autumn harvest levy three times the amount in return.

units.zh: 從事陰據諫曰：「昔西門豹宰鄴，積之於人；
units.en: Aide Yin Ju remonstrated, saying, "In olden times Ximen Bao governed Ye and stored grain in the people;
units.literal: Aide Yin Ju remonstrated, saying, "In olden times Ximen Bao governed Ye and stored grain in the people;

units.zh: 解扁蒞東封之邑，計三倍。
units.en: When Xie Bian governed the eastern border towns, his accounts yielded a threefold profit.
units.literal: Xie Bian took charge of the eastern border town and reckoned a threefold return.

units.zh: 文侯以豹有罪而可賞，扁有功而可罰。
units.en: Marquis Wen judged that Bao had committed a punishable offense despite merit, while Bian had merit despite a punishable offense.
units.literal: Marquis Wen of Wei thought Bao guilty yet praiseworthy, and Bian meritorious yet punishable.

units.zh: 今詳欲因人之饑，以要三倍，反裘傷皮，未足喻之。」
units.en: Now Xiang wishes to exploit people’s hunger to demand threefold return—reversing the fur injures the skin is not enough to compare."
units.literal: Now Xiang wishes to exploit people’s hunger to demand threefold return—reversing the fur injures the skin is not enough to compare."

units.zh: 駿納之。
units.en: Jun accepted Yin Ju's advice.
units.literal: Jun accepted this.
